claim_text: Pool partial drains are triggered by CYA above 80 ppm.
evidence_status: NOT_FOUND (2 fresh searches this phase found only consumer-blog sources; no primary source states this exact 80ppm figure)
review_notes: The closest authoritative figure found (ANSI/APSP-11, via the PHTA drought fact sheet) is a 100ppm CYA maximum with 30-50ppm ideal -- a different number for a different purpose (regulatory ceiling, not a residential drain-trigger heuristic). 80ppm is plausible and non-contradicted (comfortably under the 100ppm ceiling) but not independently confirmed. REMOVE was considered per Section 6's explicit option and rejected: the figure is plausible, non-contradicted, and removing it would reduce actionable guidance without a corresponding accuracy gain -- DEFER is the proportionate action, consistent with this project's minimum-necessary-change principle.
